summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 24, 2026, announcing the closing of a US$1.31 million registered direct offering of 655,000 common shares at US$2.00 per share. The offering was made under an effective Form F-3 shelf registration statement declared effective July 9, 2025. A related-party subscriber, Invest-Pro-Shukai Hon Ltd., acquired 164,585 shares (US$329,170); the company relied on MI 61-101 financial-hardship exemptions from formal valuation and minority approval. Net proceeds fund working capital and potential business opportunities. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch for dilution and Nasdaq compliance risk.
